expectedProductCount.evidence: BOTH R1 (30,225) and DB (30,423) are WRONG. Live HTML count on 2026-05-15T09:13Z: every catalog page renders 15 regular `node--view-mode-teaser` + 3 sticky `node--view-mode-promoted-teaser` = 18 visible cards. Promoted set rotates across pages (p0 has [1228380/1160134/628101], p1 has [1224475/1210306/1228380]). Real terminus is p1680 which shows 'No results found' div + 3 promoted only; p1679 has 1 regular + 3 promoted. Real listing count = (1679 * 15) + 1 = 25,186. This matches the live facet sums EXACTLY: province-sum (9200+4361+3960+2447+1726+1195+1089+895+113+106+94) = 25,186; category-sum (10505+4695+2468+1867+1766+878+627+623+602+492+366+109+94+52+42) = 25,184. R1's 'totalsSumCheck' note blamed the 17% drift on 'uncategorized/sticky/sold' — actual cause is R1 multiplied perPage=18 over 1680 pages, double-counting 3 sticky promoted teasers per page (3 * 1680 = 5,040 phantom listings; 30,225 - 25,186 = 5,039). Verified middle-page (p500) also shows 15 regular + 3 promoted.

apiConfig.customSelectors.evidence: R1 said the DB's `apiConfig.customSelectors` block is `runtime-consumed by the classifieds adapter`. VERIFIED FALSE. `grep -r customSelectors backend/src` returns ZERO matches. The classifieds-gunpost.ts adapter (lines 96-100) uses HARD-CODED selectors: `[class*="node--type-classified"]`, `[class*="gunpost-teaser"]`, `[class*="node--type-"][class*="teaser"]`, `[class*="classified-ad"]`. The `extractPostDate` override (line 59-80) hard-codes `.node__pubdate`. NO siteProfile.apiConfig.customSelectors path is read by any adapter. This is pure operator-documentation residue and should NOT be in the runtime profile. R1 was correct to omit; R1's diff-md text mis-described why.
